pages.title: Hawking Emitter
pages.text: A device that channels Hawking radiation, the faint thermal glow every black hole gives off as quantum fields near its horizon split into escaping and falling particles. It feels like holding a warm coal that slowly loses mass. The colder its source, the hotter it shines.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hawking radiation leaks in every direction, so I needed a waveguide that did not care which way it came in. A Topological Insulator does just that, and wrapping it around the glow in the Chronon Field Inverter let me point it.
